description: \ucN skip counting: non-default \uc2, a nested \uc1 that must be restored on '}', a negative \uN, \'hh fallbacks counted as one character each, and a '}' that ends a skip early
notes: Decodes to the 16 characters A / EURO SIGN / B / C / EM DASH / D / E / U+EFCF / F / G / SNOWMAN / H / I / SNOWMAN / J / newline; see tests/rtf.rs::unicode_skip_counter for the exact expectation. \u-4145 is code unit 61391 (U+EFCF) by signed-16-bit wraparound. The '}' after the final \u9731 truncates a two-character skip to zero, per the spec rule that a scope delimiter ends skippable data.
